name: siteco-docchat-desktop
description: Native window for Siteco Document Chat (macOS, Windows 10 and 11)
author: Luca

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs && node scripts/write-build-info.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/make-icon.mjs && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/make-icon.mjs && electron-builder --win --publish never
